pages.title: Relay Packet
pages.text: $(bold)ORSA MARTIAN COMMAND$()$(br)Recovered relay packet from the Lighthouse network.$(br2)This is the first confirmed answer from Mars after the transponder broadcast succeeds.$(br2)The packet confirms that someone heard the surface response and pushed back a launch package.

pages.title: Transmission Summary
pages.text: The speaker is startled that anyone is still alive on the surface.$(br2)They send $(bold)rocket blueprints$() and direct the respondent to use the $(bold)ORSA blast pit$().$(br2)The tone is half improvised, half rehearsed. It sounds like nobody on Mars expected to need this procedure again.
